verdict: Leads are arriving efficiently, but none are reaching your pipeline.
narrative: In the last 28 days, you received 105 leads from Meta at a cost of $16.98 per lead — a stable and efficient rate that held even as spend was deliberately pulled back this past week. The problem is downstream: of those 105 leads, only 87 appear in your CRM and zero have moved into any opportunity or intake stage, meaning the leads are arriving but going nowhere. Conversion tracking is being reconciled to close that 18-lead gap, and automated follow-up tools are being stood up now to stop the intake drain. Once SMS automation and voice access are live, leads will receive immediate contact attempts rather than falling silent — that is the fix in motion heading into October.

watch_item.issue: Every lead Meta delivers is disappearing before it reaches your intake pipeline — 105 paid leads, zero opportunities created.
watch_item.fix: Automated SMS follow-up and voice access are being activated this week so that new leads receive an immediate response and are logged into your pipeline without manual intervention.
